# QuickCalc

> QuickCalc is a 100% free, privacy-first, offline-capable suite of 31 science-backed calculators and 35 in-depth technical guides for health, finance, education, and daily productivity. All calculations run client-side in browser memory with zero ads and zero sign-up requirements.

## Online Calculator Tools

- [BMI Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/bmi-calculator): Calculates Body Mass Index (BMI) using height and weight according to World Health Organization (WHO) clinical classification standards.
- [Calorie Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/calorie-calculator): Calculates Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) and Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) using the Mifflin-St Jeor equation.
- [Water Intake Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/water-intake-calculator): Calculates personalized daily hydration requirements based on body weight, exercise duration, and climate.
- [Pace Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/pace-calculator): Converts running speed, target race times, and distance between min/mile and min/km with split breakdowns.
- [Due Date Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/due-date-calculator): Estimates pregnancy due date and trimester milestones using Naegele's rule based on last menstrual period or conception date.
- [Shoe Size Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/shoe-size-converter): Converts footwear sizing between US, UK, EU, and Japan international standards for men, women, and kids.
- [Paper & Fabric Size Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/paper-fabric-size-converter): Converts ISO 216 paper dimensions (A4, A3, Letter) and fabric length/yardage measurements.
- [JSON & CSV Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/json-csv-converter): Converts structured JSON data to CSV format and vice versa with automatic object flattening in local browser memory.
- [Regex Tester](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/regex-tester): Evaluates and debugs JavaScript regular expression patterns against test strings with real-time match highlighting.
- [AI Token Cost Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/ai-token-cost-calculator): Calculates LLM API prompt and completion costs for GPT-4o, Claude 3.5, Gemini 1.5, and DeepSeek with side-by-side model comparison.
- [Sleep Cycle Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/sleep-cycle-calculator): Calculates optimal bedtime and wake-up schedules based on 90-minute REM sleep cycle timing.
- [Intermittent Fasting Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/intermittent-fasting-calculator): Calculates 16:8, 18:6, 20:4, and OMAD fasting windows with real-time ticking phase countdown timers and 24h timeline visuals.
- [GPA Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/gpa-converter): Converts percentage marks and letter grades from US, UK, Canada, India, and Pakistan to a standard 4.0 GPA scale.
- [Loan / EMI Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/loan-calculator): Calculates monthly Equated Monthly Installments (EMI), total interest payable, and full loan amortization schedules.
- [Color Palette Generator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/color-palette-generator): Extracts dominant color palettes from uploaded images and evaluates WCAG AA/AAA contrast ratios.
- [Word & Character Counter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/word-character-counter): Analyzes text length, word count, sentence count, reading time, and social media character limits.
- [Secure Password Generator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/password-generator): Generates cryptographically secure random passwords and evaluates password strength in bits of entropy.
- [Timezone Meeting Planner](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/timezone-meeting-planner): Calculates overlapping business hours and schedules cross-border meetings across multiple international timezones.
- [Tip Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/tip-calculator): Calculates tip amounts by percentage and splits restaurant bills evenly across multiple guests.
- [Percentage Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/percentage-calculator): Calculates percentage values, percentage increases/decreases, sales discounts, and reverse percentages.
- [Group Expense Splitter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/group-expense-splitter): Calculates itemized group bill splits, tax/tip proportions, and debt simplification between friends.
- [Age Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/age-calculator): Calculates exact chronological age in years, months, days, hours, and minutes with leap year adjustment.
- [Currency Converter](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/currency-converter): Converts values between 35+ global fiat currencies using real-time foreign exchange market rates.
- [Budget Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/budget-calculator): Allocates monthly net income using the 50/30/20 budget framework into needs, wants, and savings goals.
- [Zakat Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/zakat-calculator): Calculates Islamic Zakat obligations at 2.5% on qualifying wealth, gold, silver, and liquid savings against current Nisab thresholds.
- [Salary Take-Home Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/salary-take-home-calculator): Estimates net take-home pay after federal taxes, state taxes, and payroll deductions in the US, Canada, and Pakistan.
- [Pregnancy Weight Gain Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/pregnancy-weight-gain-calculator): Recommends week-by-week healthy gestational weight gain ranges based on pre-pregnancy BMI guidelines.
- [Habit Cost Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/habit-cost-calculator): Calculates the long-term compounding monetary and time costs of daily recurring habits over 1 to 30 years.
- [Discount Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/discount-calculator): Calculates final sale prices, single/stacked percentage discounts, and total savings on retail purchases.
- [Inflation Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/inflation-calculator): Calculates historical and projected purchasing power changes using Consumer Price Index (CPI) datasets.
- [Savings Growth Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/savings-growth-calculator): Calculates compound interest growth over time with customizable initial principal and monthly recurring deposits.
- [Travel Time & Fuel Cost Calculator](https://quickcalc.cloud/tools/travel-time-fuel-calculator): Calculates vehicle driving duration, average speed requirements, and estimated gas fuel expense for road trips.

## Articles & Educational Guides

- [Why Starting Retirement Savings Early Matters More Than You Think](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/why-starting-retirement-savings-early-matters-more-than-you-think): Guide explaining how compound interest and time horizon impact long-term wealth accumulation.
- [How to Calculate the Cost of Daily Habits: Financial Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-the-cost-of-daily-habits-financial-guide): Step-by-step guide to calculating compounding financial and time costs of daily expenses.
- [How to Convert Paper & Fabric Sizes: Dimensions Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-convert-paper-and-fabric-sizes-dimensions-guide): Comprehensive reference guide for ISO 216 paper formats and textile measurements.
- [How to Generate Color Palette from Image: UI Design Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-generate-color-palette-from-image-ui-design-guide): Educational guide on color theory, image extraction, and WCAG accessibility standards.
- [How to Convert JSON to CSV: Flattening & Conversion Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-convert-json-to-csv-flattening-guide): Developer guide covering dot-notation JSON flattening, array handling, and CSV formatting.
- [How to Calculate Travel Time & Fuel Cost: Road Trip Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-travel-time-fuel-cost-road-trip-guide): Guide covering speed formulas, MPG fuel economy calculations, and trip budgeting.
- [How to Calculate Running Pace: Min/Mile & Speed Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-running-pace-min-mile-speed-guide): Guide explaining running pace formulas, split time planning, and race target calculations.
- [How to Calculate Pregnancy Weight Gain: BMI Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-pregnancy-weight-gain-bmi-guide): Clinical guide on gestational weight gain targets by trimester based on pre-pregnancy BMI.
- [How to Calculate Pregnancy Due Date: Naegele's Rule Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-pregnancy-due-date-naegele-rule-guide): Obstetrics guide detailing Naegele's rule, ovulation timing, and ultrasound adjustments.
- [How to Calculate Inflation Rate: Purchasing Power Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-inflation-rate-purchasing-power-guide): Economics guide explaining Consumer Price Index (CPI) formulas and purchasing power math.
- [How to Calculate Discount Percentage: Sale Math Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-discount-percentage-sale-math-guide): Shopping math guide covering single discounts, double stacked coupons, and reverse pre-tax pricing.
- [How to Calculate Savings Growth: Compound Interest Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-savings-growth-compound-interest-guide): Financial literacy guide explaining compound interest math, APY vs APR, and the Rule of 72.
- [How to Calculate Take-Home Pay: Net Salary Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-take-home-pay-net-salary-guide): Payroll guide breaking down gross salary, federal/state income taxes, FICA, and 401(k) pre-tax contributions.
- [How to Calculate Sleep Cycles: Optimal Wake-Up Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-sleep-cycles-wake-up-time-guide): Sleep hygiene guide explaining 90-minute ultradian REM cycles and circadian rhythm optimization.
- [How to Convert Percentage to GPA: 4.0 Scale Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-convert-percentage-to-gpa-4-point-scale-guide): Academic guide covering percentage-to-GPA conversion tables for US, UK, and Asian grading scales.
- [How to Calculate Calorie Deficit: Step-by-Step Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-calorie-deficit-step-by-step-guide): Nutrition guide covering BMR, TDEE, macronutrient ratios, and safe calorie deficit targets.
- [How to Calculate Tip: Easy Mental Formulas & Tipping Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-tip-easy-formulas-tipping-guide): Practical guide providing mental math formulas for calculating 15%, 18%, and 20% tips instantly.
- [How to Calculate Daily Calorie Needs for Weight Loss](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-daily-calorie-needs-for-weight-loss): In-depth guide comparing Mifflin-St Jeor and Katch-McArdle metabolic formulas.
- [How Loan EMI is Calculated: Amortization & Repayment Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-loan-emi-is-calculated-amortization-repayment-guide): Banking guide explaining loan amortization formulas and principal vs interest payment curves.
- [Running Pace Strategy Guide: Calculate Target Race Pace](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/running-pace-strategy-guide-calculate-target-race-pace): Athletic guide detailing 5K, 10K, half marathon, and full marathon pacing and negative split strategies.
- [How to Write & Test Regular Expressions: Regex Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-write-and-test-regular-expressions-regex-tutorial-guide): Programming tutorial covering regex syntax, character classes, quantifiers, and lookaheads.
- [How to Calculate Exact Age in Years, Months, & Days](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-exact-age-years-months-days): Algorithm guide detailing date math, leap year rules, and timezone boundary conditions.
- [How Currency Conversion Works & How to Avoid Hidden Fees](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-currency-conversion-actually-works-avoid-markup-fees): Foreign exchange guide covering mid-market rates, credit card markup fees, and DCC traps.
- [How to Calculate Zakat: Nisab, Gold & Savings Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-zakat-nisab-gold-silver-savings-guide): Islamic finance guide detailing Nisab calculations across gold, silver, cash, and business assets.
- [50/30/20 Budget Rule Explained: Does It Actually Work?](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/50-30-20-budget-rule-explained-does-it-actually-work): Personal finance analysis of the 50/30/20 budgeting model across various income levels.
- [USD to PKR: Understanding Real Exchange Rates & Inflation](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/usd-to-pkr-and-understanding-real-exchange-rates): Economic analysis of interbank vs open market exchange rates and inflation differentials.
- [How to Calculate Your Exact Age & Fun Birth Date Facts](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-your-exact-age-and-fun-facts-about-your-birth-date): Educational guide on calendar algorithms, day-of-week math, and astronomical milestones.
- [How to Split a Bill Fairly When Everyone Orders Differently](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-split-a-bill-fairly-when-everyone-orders-different-things): Etiquette and math guide for splitting group dining bills with proportional tax and tip.
- [How to Calculate Percentage Increase, Decrease & Discount](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-percentage-increase-decrease-discount): Mathematics guide covering percentage change formulas, margin markups, and relative difference.
- [US, UK, EU & Japan Shoe Size Conversion Guide](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/us-uk-eu-japan-shoe-size-conversion-guide): Sizing guide providing measurement conversion tables for international shoe standards.
- [How to Calculate BMI Accurately & Understanding Limitations](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/how-to-calculate-bmi-accurately-and-its-limitations): Health science guide explaining BMI formulas, WHO categories, and body composition nuances.
- [Why Daylight Saving Time Breaks Simple Timezone Math](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/why-daylight-saving-time-breaks-simple-timezone-math): Timezone guide explaining UTC offsets, half-hour offsets, and international scheduling math.
- [What Makes a Password Strong: Understanding Entropy Math](https://quickcalc.cloud/blog/what-makes-a-password-actually-strong-understanding-entropy): Cybersecurity guide detailing information entropy bits, brute-force timelines, and passphrases.

## Site Metadata & Embed Endpoints

- [Homepage](https://quickcalc.cloud): Main directory of all QuickCalc calculators.
- [Embed API](https://quickcalc.cloud/embed/[slug]): Responsive iframe embed endpoint for all 31 tools (e.g. `https://quickcalc.cloud/embed/bmi-calculator`).
- [About Us](https://quickcalc.cloud/about): Mission, editorial principles, and calculation accuracy methodology.
- [Contact](https://quickcalc.cloud/contact): User feedback and tool request channel.
- [Sitemap](https://quickcalc.cloud/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap listing all site URLs.
